description: Delete an inbox and its events. Auth: Authorization Bearer read token header. Irreversible: under a PAP session this needs a user approval first (Operations v3) - the first call returns the operation to approve; retry with the approval in _meta[personalagentprotocol.org/approval].

inbox_id.description: The inbox id returned when the inbox was created (private; the slug in the ingest URL is the public part).

name: delete_inbox
